summary: Schema validator/mutator for INTENT.md and LEDGER.md (INTENT-mode planning contract + BFS realization trail), plus TASKS.md/SESSION.md query helpers used by /z-execute and the context curator.

entry_points.summary: Validates INTENT.md frontmatter (6 fields) + required sections per level; returns ValidationResult
Flags bare 'runs'/'works' criteria with no observable object; returns list[LintFailure]
Sets frozen_at back to 'pending' for amendment; idempotent; returns (was_reopened, 'pending')
Idempotent UTC ISO stamp into frozen_at; returns (was_frozen_now, frozen_at_value)
Creates LEDGER.md with required frontmatter if absent; idempotent; returns bool
Phase 8 TASKS.md sanity checks: canonical headings, acyclic deps, criterion coverage/deferral
Per-criterion met|unmet|unknown + done|continue verdict from INTENT+LEDGER+diff; conservative
Computes /z-execute final aggregate-review required/not-required decision from TASKS+workstreams+flags
sha256 of sorted [x] task-ids; canonical resume key shared between curator and orchestrator
Id of the last [x] heading in file order; human hint only, not load-bearing
Comma-separated ids for every [x] task in file order; checkpoint-boundary completion set for curator prompts
First [ ] task whose declared deps are all in done-set
Prints done/pending/in_progress/other counts; used by check-compaction.sh and context-curator done_count
Timestamp of most recent context_curated event from metrics.jsonl
Extracts scalar YAML frontmatter field from SESSION.md
Shell wrapper delegating to intent-schema.py validate-intent (+ optional lint)

invariants: evaluate_acceptance conservative invariant: unknown treated as unmet; VERDICT:done only when every criterion is STATUS_MET
done_set_hash must be called via session-helpers.sh by both writer (context-curator) and reader (z-execute) — never re-implemented inline
freeze_intent is idempotent: already-frozen INTENT.md returns (False, existing_ts) without modification
reopen_intent operates only on the frontmatter block; body text with matching 'frozen_at:' lines is never touched
bootstrap_ledger is creation-only: existing LEDGER.md with any content is left untouched
All session-helpers.sh functions are stdout-only, exit 0, no side effects

validate_tasks requires every current-level criterion to be advanced by a task's Advances line or explicitly deferred; unions of coverage across Advances + deferred must equal the target criterion set

compute_aggregate_review_gate is a pure OR of 6 triggers (task_count>8, workstream_count>1, parallel_batch_count>1, high_risk_flag, criteria_mapped_to_multiple_workstreams, metadata_missing_or_invalid); missing/unreadable/invalid workstreams or execution-strategy input is itself a trigger, not a silent skip
gotchas: evaluate_acceptance: ledger-cited criterion with empty or missing diff is 'unknown' (not 'met') — no diff = cannot confirm code changed
done_set_hash supports two TASKS.md formats: inline backtick status on heading and bare [x] list item preceding heading — both must produce identical hashes
freeze_intent has a dual-fallback: re.sub on full file if frozen_at not in parsed frontmatter; second fallback inserts before closing ---
Level L1 (quick) requires only Acceptance checklist; L2 (standard) and L3 (deep) also require Not doing + Consider for this
planning_mode valid values: 'intent' or 'full' only — any other value is a validation error
lint heuristic: 'runs and exits 0' passes; bare 'runs' or 'works' with only filler words after it fails
CLI exit codes: 0=valid/done, 1=errors/continue, 2=usage error — evaluate-acceptance exits 1 for VERDICT:continue

validate_tasks treats a task's '**Depends on:**' as invalid unless it is the literal em-dash '—'; any other value is flagged even while still being parsed into the dependency graph for cycle detection

compute_aggregate_review_gate only counts tasks whose heading carries a done marker ([x] or {status}); active workstreams exclude status=='failed'; a done task with no workstream mapping forces workstreams_missing_task_mapping

task_status_counts and completed_task_ids/last_done_task were added to session-helpers.sh after the prior doc snapshot — task_status_counts backs check-compaction.sh + context-curator done_count, completed_task_ids backs curator checkpoint-boundary prompts

memories.text: INTENT-mode final review is only meaningful after LEDGER.md exists and is flushed; absence blocks realized-decision/deviation review, not just reporting polish.
